messages:
incident-bot: PAGERS 🔔 Severity: P2 - service: inference-api - symptom: sustained 95th-pct latency > 1200ms for /v1/generate across eu-west-1 for last 6m. Pager routed to carmen-sre. Link: https://incidents.redwood/1750054321

carmen-sre: ack, looking. I'm on call. Starting triage: checking pool health and KV cache hit rates.

carmen-sre: quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep gpu` shows 3/5 replicas Restarting, OOM events in logs. KV cache miss rate spiked to 82% around 15:08 UTC.

sam-eng: @carmen-sre I can try scaling dedicated pool temporarily. Want me to bump replica count to 7?

carmen-sre: yes please, do +2 now and hold. Also enable fallback routing to model-small for non-SLA tenants.

sam-eng: doing scale now. command: ```
# scale dedicated pool
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/redwood/pools/dedicated-eu/scale" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"replicas":7}'
```

oncall-bot: scale job accepted by infra. Estimated time to ready: ~45s.

alex-ml: seeing KV engine logs with repeated `KVCache::evict` and `cuda out of memory` lines. Likely root cause is bad batch sizing combined with a rare token distribution spike from a customer.

maria-pm: any known customer impact? Liz, can you flag if any enterprise tenants reported errors?

liz-prod: I checked the support queue - two customers reported timeouts from 15:06-15:18 UTC. No SSO/PII exposure. CHURN risk low but latency visible for product search features.

kyle-ops: scale done, pods rolling. I'm patching a hotfix to reduce batch max size from 64->32 to lower OOM risk: ```
PATCH /configs/serving/global
{ "max_batch": 32 }
``` Applying to eu-west-1 now.

carmen-sre: hotfix applied. Observability: 95th-pct latency dropping from 1400ms -> 650ms over next 90s. Good.

sam-eng: also flipped routing rule to route non-committed tenants to model-small as a temporary fallback. command: ```
POST /routing/policy
{ "selector": "tenant.commit=\"false\"", "action": "route:model-small" }
```

oncall-bot: routing policy change accepted.

carmen-sre: incident mitigated. No further pager noise. Moving to post-incident follow-up and handoff.

maria-pm: thanks all. Scheduling postmortem sync — propose tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Agenda: timeline, root cause, action items, customer impact, runbook updates. Who can attend?

alex-ml: I can do it. Will bring logs and a short repro of batch-trigger.

sam-eng: I'll be there. I also want to propose an autoscale tweak and an alert suppressor for short spike windows.

liz-prod: I'll join for customer impact notes.

carmen-sre: assign owners for immediate action items in this thread so we can track:
- ticket: INFR-4567 created for follow-ups.
- action 1: tighten alert threshold and add sustained-duration window -> owner: carmen-sre -> due: 2025-11-10
- action 2: add synthetic load test hitting long-tail tokens to pipeline -> owner: alex-ml -> due: 2025-11-14
- action 3: runbook: add steps for KV cache surge and exact commands to scale pools and apply fallback routing -> owner: sam-eng -> due: 2025-11-12
- action 4: postmortem doc and customer impact summary -> owner: liz-prod -> due: 2025-11-11

sam-eng: noted. I'll open a PR against infra/runbooks/oncall-playbook.md with the scale commands + routing snippets. Will mark it draft and link here.

sam-eng: PR: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pull/232 - draft. Includes playbook checklist: ack -> verify KV hits -> run scale -> apply batch cap -> fallback routing -> notify product/support -> monitor 15m.

carmen-sre: please include exact kubectl and ops-api commands and expected roll times. Add a section for when to escalate to SEV1 vs SEV2.

alex-ml: for repro, I'm attaching the minimal script we used to reproduce high-tail token distribution. (pasting snippet): ```
# synthetic tail tokens
for i in {1..500}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -d '{"prompt":"'$(python -c "import random; print(' '.join(['qwertyuiop']*random.randint(1,200)))")'" }' &
done
```

maria-pm: good. For the postmortem meeting, I'll create a calendar invite and include the incident timeline doc. Please add any relevant logs to the doc before meeting.

liz-prod: customer communications: I'll send a brief note to affected customers summarizing what happened and the mitigation steps after the postmortem is ready.

kyle-ops: small ops note — suggested improvement: make the batch cap configurable per-model variant so we can avoid global hotfixes. Filing as feature request to backlog (JIRA INFOPS-987).

carmen-sre: wrap-up: incident declared mitigated at 15:21 UTC. Postmortem sync confirmed for 2025-11-06 11:00 UTC (calendar invite sent). Action owners and dates above. I'll update the incident ticket INFR-4567 with this thread and add 'runbook-update' label.

incident-bot: Incident 1750054321 status -> mitigated. Postmortem required -> scheduled. Link: https://incidents.redwood/1750054321/postmortem

sam-eng: one more ask — let's add a small blameless note to runbook PR reminding folks to stick to the handoff checklist: who, what, where, and next steps.

carmen-sre: agreed. Also we'll add a short on-call training module for 'KV cache surges' during the next oncall rotation. Assigned to: sam-eng -> due 2025-11-20.

maria-pm: thanks everyone. If anything new crops up, post here and I'll re-schedule. :thumbsup:

liz-prod: thanks team :clap:
